text:
Peaceful lull or not, many thanks for your second message. We understand that your complaint concerns the handling of your companion animal travel arrangements and the distress caused by the way your concerns were addressed. Please accept our sincere apology for the inconvenience and worry this has caused you.

At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk is expected to serve travelers with patience, clarity, and care, and it is clear from your account that we fell short of that standard. Your situation has been reviewed with the relevant team so that the details of your experience are understood in full. We also appreciate the opportunity to reinforce the importance of calm, respectful communication when a passenger is anxious about a pet's journey.

Your complaint has been taken seriously by the senior coordinator, who has asked that the operational guidance shared with crews be checked again for consistency and ease of use. This includes the reminders given to staff on handling companion animals, confirming the condition of the travel space, and responding promptly when a traveler raises a concern. We want you to know that your report is helpful in improving everyday desk work and in preventing avoidable frustration for other passengers and their animals.

If the matter affected your confidence in traveling with Aurelia Skyways, we regret that deeply. Our aim is always to make the process reassuring, especially when a beloved companion animal is involved. We recognize that practical support matters just as much as courtesy, and both must be present at every stage of service. Where a mistake has been made, we are committed to correcting it with care and accountability.

Thank you for bringing this to us in such a clear way. Your feedback has been passed on so that the matter may be addressed within our internal review process, and so that the same concern is less likely to arise again. We remain available to assist with future companion animal travel needs and will strive to provide the steady, professional support you should have received from the start.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
